"""Differential tests for {{SPEC_ID}}: point assertions checked against the implementation (generated by /draft-laws).

Each test is one fixed-input proposition the spec states (a decision-table row). It calls the
implementation named by `impl-of:` directly and asserts its real return value; no Bend encoding.
`# source:` ties each test to the spec section it was drafted from (`draft_laws.py check --tests`).
"""
# spec: {{SPEC_ID}}
# impl-of: {{IMPL_PATH}}

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[{{REPO_DEPTH}}]


def _load(name: str, path: Path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


impl = _load("{{IMPL_MODULE}}", REPO / "{{IMPL_PATH}}")


# source: {{SPEC_ID}} §{{SECTION}} sha256:{{SECTION_HASH}}
def test_{{CANDIDATE_NAME}}():
    # {{PROPOSITION}}
    assert impl.{{FUNCTION}}({{ARGUMENTS}}) == {{EXPECTED}}
